name: Operbat
look: a red bat in a golden opera mask with curling horns, half-closed purple eyes, a white ruffled collar, a tattered yellow cloak, raised red wings licked by flames and a flame-tipped tail
entry: It hides its face behind a golden mask and performs for anyone who will listen, singing in a voice so high that windows crack. It never takes the mask off.
how: Evolve Sounflame at level 16. It learns Confuse Ray when it evolves.
